description: This file defines a React component for a navigation menu in the Notesnook application, including routes, tabs, and UI interactions such as drag-and-drop reordering, menu actions, and navigation logic.

classes.name: NavigationTabItem
classes.description: Defines the structure for navigation tab items including id, icon, title, and actions.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a route in the navigation menu with id, title, path, icon, optional tag, and login requirement.

classes.name: ReorderableList
classes.description: A generic React component enabling drag-and-drop reordering of list items with persistence.

methods.name: NavigationMenu
methods.description: Main React component rendering the navigation menu with routes, tabs, and nested items.

methods.name: Routes
methods.description: Renders a list of route items with drag-and-drop reordering.

methods.name: RouteItem
methods.description: Renders individual route items with navigation and context menu actions.

methods.name: Colors
methods.description: Displays a list of color items with reordering and context menu options.

methods.name: ColorItem
methods.description: Renders a color item with actions like rename and remove.

methods.name: Shortcuts
methods.description: Displays user shortcuts with reordering capabilities.

methods.name: ShortcutItem
methods.description: Renders a shortcut item with navigation and removal actions.

methods.name: ItemCount
methods.description: Displays the count of notes, reminders, or other items associated with a navigation element.

methods.name: NavigationDropdown
methods.description: Provides a user profile and settings menu with theme toggle, upgrade, and account actions.

methods.name: ReorderableList
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop reordering of list items with persistence and feature checks.

methods.name: orderItems
methods.description: Sorts items based on a specified order array, appending any items not in the order.

methods.name: toMenuItems
methods.description: Converts a list of items into menu items with toggle visibility and feature checks.

methods.name: navigateToRoute
methods.description: Handles navigation to a specified route, toggling list pane or resetting search as needed.
